_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Fifty-three individually reviewed DOJ corpus people from three distinct, source-defined drug-case cohorts. Charge allegations and guilty-plea sentencing outcomes are separated; exact charge/unsealing/sentencing dates are used, not silently inferred from publication dates. USA markers concern source-described historical conduct or alleged conduct, not address or nationality. No person-to-person edges, inferred organizational or gang membership, precise/current location, route, or portrait.

evidence.claim: DOJ’s 2019 indictment individually names Tionna Jones among the 16 charged in Count 1 of a Memphis-focused drug conspiracy alleged to have operated from December 2018 through May 2019. USA is an alleged historical market link, not a current position or gang-membership claim.

sources.title: The Remaining Defendant in a 16-Member Drug Trafficking Organization With Ties to Grape Street Crips Gang Sentenced
sources.claim: Tionna Jones: DOJ reports a drug-offense guilty plea and a sentence of 37 months imprisonment on 2021-06-22. Tionna Jones pleaded guilty to conspiracy to possess with the intent to distribute 50 grams or more of a mixture and substance containing a detectable amount of methamphetamine. This is a historical court outcome, not a claim of present custody or individual gang membership.
